src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    mk=markers[0] if len(markers)==1 else None
    if mk is None: return g
    nines=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mk]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==mk: continue
            for x in range(len(nines)):
                for y in range(x+1,len(nines)):
                    a,b=nines[x],nines[y]
                    if not (a[0]==b[0] or a[1]==b[1]): continue
                    if (min(a[0],b[0])<=i<=max(a[0],b[0])) and (min(a[1],b[1])<=j<=max(a[1],b[1])):
                        g[i][j]=3
    return g
'''
